description: Public Xquik documentation for REST API, webhooks, MCP, OAuth, SDKs, extraction workflows, monitors, and X/Twitter automation.
rules: Use quickstart.mdx first for the initial API key and authenticated request flow.
Use api-reference/overview.mdx for REST base URL, auth, errors, rate limits, and pagination conventions.
Use sdks/ for TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, C#, Ruby, PHP, CLI, and Terraform install docs.
Use mcp/ and webhooks/ for agent integrations and signed event delivery.
Keep implementation details public-safe; use Xquik, read service, write service, or browser service wording.
